description: This file defines the object OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction, which contains utility functions for handling UI actions in the OpenClaw application, including extracting action names from JSON objects, sanitizing tag values for use in messages, formatting agent messages with given parameters, and dispatching status events as JavaScript strings.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts the action name from a JsonObject representing a user action, checking 'name' and 'action' fields.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be safe for use as a tag value by replacing invalid characters with underscores.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Formats a message string with various parameters, sanitizing each value for safe inclusion.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript snippet dispatching a custom event indicating the status of an UI action.
